import hashlib
import subprocess

out=root/"reports/research/510300_post_frozen_2026_historical_joint_sample_source_admission_v1"
at=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def rel(p):
    return str(Path(p).relative_to(root)).replace("\\","/")
def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,data):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("本轮实际产物已存在，不覆盖或重复运行："+name)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p)}
def read_json(p):
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git",*args],cwd=root,text=True,encoding="utf-8").strip()
